    • דו"חות על מתיחות: ארה"ב מתח ביקורת על ישראל שהשפיעה על המשא ומתן; המתיחות מתוארת כזמנית.
  • אחר
    • שווקים תנודתיים; האיזור הכלכלי מושפע מסימני הפסקת אש ושיחות.
    • חקירות וכיסוי תקשורתי על תקיפה קודמת שבה נהרגו ילדים איראנים — סיכון תדמיתי ממשיך.

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hrs)

  • Pause announced: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET. He says talks “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks.
  • Diplomacy: Pakistan mediating. Pakistan PM says US and Iran agreed on deal wording (AP). Multiple outlets report Iran refuses to meet US envoys; reports of growing rift between Iran’s president and the IRGC.
  • Air operations: NATO statement: US flew ~5,000 sorties from Europe. Flight scans show several military flights and persistent air activity. Regional airports closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan.
  • Northern border: Hezbollah active daily. Continued missile/rocket exchanges with Israel (sustained low-to-medium intensity).
  • Maritime/Hormuz: Iran allows passage for Russia, India, China; blocks other flagged traffic.
  • Politics (Israel/US): US Congress blocked a vote to restrict military funding to Israel. 22 Democrats joined GOP to block a Lebanon War Powers resolution.
  • Cyber & economy: Israel reports cyber incidents have tripled year-on-year. Oil prices tick higher as diplomatic uncertainty persists; Iran says exports crippled under US blockade.
  • Operational note: Expect continued air sorties and daily northern-proxy attacks. Watch the Apr 6 pause deadline for potential resumption or violations.
  • 🟢 Good News: Pakistan mediation + reported deal wording and the pause may buy diplomatic time. Congressional action preserved Israeli military funding.
Threat assessment: Escalating — fragile pause amid high operational tempo and frequent northern exchanges.

Situation Report — Day 27

Current tactical picture:
  • Airstrikes and missile exchanges continue. Israeli/US strikes inside Iran reported; Hezbollah/IRGC-linked launches hit northern Israel daily.

Key developments

  • Trump announced a SECOND pause on US strikes against Iranian energy infrastructure for 10 days (expires Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET). He says talks are "going very well." Iran denies direct talks.
  • Pakistan mediating. Pakistani PM says wording of a deal agreed; Tehran disputes high-level meeting claims.
  • Previous 5-day pause was violated by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

Military & operational

  • NATO chief: US flew ~5,000 sorties from European bases in the Iran campaign.
  • Airspace: major regional airports remain closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan).
  • Commercial/military flight activity elevated in adjacent corridors—continued airborne ISR and strike support.

Northern Border

  • Hezbollah active daily with rockets/mortar strikes and local shelling. Frontline tension remains high. Civilian shelters and IDF readiness unchanged.

Hormuz & shipping

  • Iran allows passage through Hormuz to Russia, India, China; restricts others. Trade corridors fragmented.

Diplomacy & politics

  • US pause framed as negotiating leverage. Iran publicly rejects direct envoys. Mixed signals increase risk of miscalculation.
  • US domestic politics: Congress blocked a vote to restrict military funding to Israel.
🟢 Good News
  • A second US pause reduces immediate pressure on Iranian energy assets for 10 days.
Threat assessment: escalating

מפרץ הורמוז ושילוח
